text: The compiler shall deliver each intermediate representation passed between its compilation stages to the next stage without any modification.

The air traffic control software must validate the group signature attached to each flight plan message using the group public key, so that the controller can confirm the message came from a registered airline without learning which dispatcher signed it.
The air traffic control software should be able to encrypt radar track records with a symmetric cipher so that unauthorised readers cannot interpret them.
The web browser must allow bookmarks and saved form entries to be modified solely by the profile owner who has been verified in the current session.
The online banking application shall admit a customer only if the entered customer identifier and credential are confirmed as valid, and shall redisplay the sign-in form when they are not.

The sales forecasting system shall verify the claimed identity of each regional analyst by validating the digital certificate presented at login against the company's certificate authority before accepting forecast submissions.
The sales forecasting system shall verify each analyst's supplied credentials against the registered user records before opening any forecasting workspace.
The electronic purse must attach a cryptographic signature to every balance-load record so that any later change to the amount can be detected.
The compiler's online account portal shall let a registered developer who has lost access obtain a reset of the credential through a link sent to the email address on file.
The simulation software shall check, upon receiving proprietary model parameters from a remote solver node, that the parameters arrived under encryption and shall reject them if they did not.
The compiler must verify the checksums of its standard library and toolchain components at start-up and must refuse to compile if any component has been modified.
The screen capture tool shall hold the keys used to encrypt saved recordings in the operating system's hardware-backed key store, preventing other applications from reading them.
If the compiler's licence server connection receives a re-sent licence grant that it has already honoured, the compiler shall abort the running build job and release its licence checkout.
The smart-card electronic purse shall attach a hash value to its stored balance and must refuse to operate when the recomputed value differs from the stored one.

The screen capture tool shall check that every recording's metadata fields, such as duration and resolution, are within valid ranges and shall refuse to store entries that duplicate an existing recording identifier.
The web browser must transmit form submissions only over encrypted connections so that intermediaries on the network path are unable to read the submitted values.
The payroll and human resources management system must compare a stored hash of each approved payslip batch with a recomputed hash before release, and block payment on any mismatch.

The simulation software must let a project owner define, per module (model editor, solver, results viewer), which users may view its content and which users may alter it, with each grant independent of the others.
The simulation software must detect and block attempts to inject malicious scripts through model files and shall maintain correct operation of running simulations during such attempts.
The compiler must remove user names, file paths and source snippets from crash reports before they are made available to support staff.
The online banking application shall guarantee that the debit and credit legs of a transfer are recorded with identical amounts, and shall reject any entry that breaks that match.

Once an analyst's forecasting job ends, the sales forecasting system must purge the intermediate customer-level datasets and cached results generated for that job so that later users cannot read them.
The smart-home controller must let a registered resident open the control dashboard once the controller has confirmed that resident's identity.

The database server shall recompute the checksum covering the row count and sum of an aggregated ledger whenever a transaction is rolled back, and shall retain the rolled-back entry unchanged until archival.
The air traffic control software may use public-key encryption to conceal session keys when they are distributed to remote control towers.

The sales forecasting system shall reject repeated submissions of crafted input designed to exhaust its model-training service and shall inform the system administrator whenever such a submission is blocked.
The web browser shall require a user to prove ownership of a sync profile through a verified credential before restoring saved bookmarks and stored logins on a device.
The patient-record system shall validate the accuracy of every submitted clinical entry and shall detect and reject injected or manipulated entries that attempt to bypass those checks.
The electronic purse shall require the cardholder to enter the correct PIN before it authorises any payment.
When the web browser finds that an authentication assertion from a site has been resubmitted by an attacker, it shall terminate the affected browsing session and clear its authenticated state.
The smart-home IoT controller must verify a keyed authentication tag on every command received from a paired hub and discard any command whose tag does not match.
The screen capture tool shall require each user to sign in with an enrolled account and a valid credential before it can be launched on a managed workstation.
The smart-home IoT controller shall discard any actuator command that carries a timestamp outside the permitted freshness window, so that recorded commands cannot be resent to operate a door lock.
The sales forecasting system must inform the analyst, for each imported dataset, whether it carries a verifiable source stamp that confirms the identity of the data provider.
When a customer's booking session times out, the online booking system shall erase the personal details and payment data entered during that session from all temporary storage.
The compiler shall compute an MD5 digest of each source file and compare it with the expected value so that a modified source file is detected before compilation proceeds.

The smart-home controller shall offer installed device integrations a service that converts arbitrary sensor and camera payloads into ciphertext before they leave the hub, so that only the paired mobile app can read them.

The payroll system shall ensure that simultaneous edits to an employee's record from different workstations never leave the record partially updated, and shall permit modification only by users holding an edit role.

The smart-card electronic purse shall attach a cryptographic checksum to the stored balance and shall reject any balance value whose checksum does not match, so that corruption or tampering is detected.
